title: Firebase and Cloud Firestore
scope: A complete Firebase/Cloud Firestore course covering Standard and Enterprise editions, Native Core and Pipeline operations, document modeling, SDKs, realtime listeners, offline persistence, queries and indexes, transactions, Security Rules, IAM/App Check, scaling and hotspots, aggregations, vector search, MongoDB compatibility, TTL, backups/PITR, encryption/networking, observability, cost engineering, migration, and production architecture.
coverage_note: Current 2026 Firestore Standard and Enterprise capabilities, including Native Core/Pipeline operations, MongoDB compatibility, vector search, Query Explain/Insights, scheduled backups, and PITR
